content: Unfortunately, I just closed the biggest repository I've haver maintained (6.3k stars). It's time to say goodbye to File Browser, which I started in 2015. It's been over half an year looking for maintainers and no one showed up. It is archived. https://github.com/filebrowser/filebrowser/issues/532
